blurb: Guests can rent canoes, kayaks, paddleboards, swan paddleboats, and other equipment to explore Lake Junaluska. The outfitter also rents equipment for tennis, pickleball, mini-golf, shuffleboard, and cornhole. The lake offers guided lake cruises and private boat tours aboard the Cherokee IV.
